passName.description: A unique identifier for the pass used in audits and during config extension.

recordTrace.description: Records a trace of the pass when enabled. Available to gatherers during afterPass as traceData.trace and to audits in artifacts.traces.

useThrottling.description: Enables throttling of the pass when enabled.

pauseAfterLoadMs.description:
The number of milliseconds to wait after the load event before the pass can continue.
Used to ensure the page has had time for post-load JavaScript to execute before ending a trace. (Default: 0)

networkQuietThresholdMs.description:
The number of milliseconds since the last network request to wait before the page should be considered to have reached 'network quiet'.
Used to ensure the page has had time for the full waterfall of network requests to complete before ending a trace. (Default: 5000)

cpuQuietThresholdMs.description: The number of milliseconds to wait after 'cpu quiet' before the pass can continue

pauseAfterNetworkQuietMs.description:
The number of milliseconds to wait after 'network quiet' before the pass can continue.
Used to ensure the page has had time for post-network-quiet JavaScript to execute before ending a trace. (Default: 0)

blockedUrlPatterns.description: URLs of requests to block while loading the page. Basic wildcard support using *.

gatherers.description: The list of gatherers to run on this pass. This property is required and on extension will be concatenated with the existing set of gatherers.

name: LighthouseConfigPass
